articles.title: Arkema: Disclosure of Trading in Own Shares From 24 August to 25 August 2026
articles.summary: LA DÉFENSE, France, September 01, 2026--Regulatory News: In accordance with applicable regulations, Arkema (Paris:AKE) announces having carried out the following share buyback transactions in accordance with Article 5 §2 of Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 from 24 August to 25 August 2026.
